sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: The sentence begins at the bottom of printed page 172 and is completed at the top of page 173. The admitted original PDF clearly states that the Mitte itself can be the site of serious Triebgefahren, explicitly Affektgefahr and Ichgefahr.

sourceExcerpt: daß die Mitte oft die Stelle ernster Triebgefahren (Affektgefahr und Ichgefahr) sein kann.
romanianRendering: Szondi precizează că Mitte nu funcționează numai ca sistem de Stellungnahme/Zensur față de Rand, ci poate deveni ea însăși sediul unor Triebgefahren serioase, numite aici Affektgefahr și Ichgefahr.
doctrinalStatement: În metoda Rand–Mitte, funcția protectivă a Mitte nu trebuie absolutizată: sursa afirmă explicit că Mitte poate fi ea însăși locul unor Triebgefahren, în special Affektgefahr și Ichgefahr. Această calificare împiedică lectura unilaterală a P/Sch ca simplu sistem protector și cere evaluarea configurației proprii a Mitte.
conditions: Use inside the source-defined Rand–Mitte analysis after the structural role of Mitte has been established.
exceptions: Do not infer a concrete affective disorder, Ego disorder or clinical diagnosis merely because P/Sch belongs to the Mitte.
Do not treat the general protective function of Mitte as evidence that a particular Mitte configuration is intact or effective.
scopeNotes: The source immediately turns from this qualification to characterological and psychopathological variations of the Mitte in Tables 13 and 14.

relations.note: Qualifies the general Mitte-as-protection doctrine by stating that the Mitte itself may become a site of Triebgefahr.
Belongs to part II of the source-defined Rand–Mitte method.

reviewNotes: Canonical BODY U002498-U002499 checked against deterministic P0 evidence; admitted PDF printed pages 172-173 confirms the sentence across the page break.
P2A only; no affective or Ego diagnosis rule is introduced.
